article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Devyn Martin’s 23 points helped Lipscomb defeat Belmont 88-75 on Tuesday. Martin added five rebounds for the Bisons (2-2). Titas Sargiunas scored 17 points while shooting 7 for 12, including 3 for 8 from beyond the arc. T.K. Simpkins went 6 of 15 from the field (2 for 5 from 3-point range) to finish with 16 points. Jack Smiley led the Bruins (2-1) in scoring, finishing with 23 points. Jabez Jenkins added 14 points and 10 rebounds for Belmont. Aleksa Ristic had 10 points and seven assists. Up next Both teams play on Saturday. Lipscomb visits Western Carolina and Belmont plays Furman at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
